{{Quote|You look like my daddy.|Shaeeah, to Rex|<ref name="The Deserter">{{TCW|The Deserter}}</ref>}}
'''Shaeeah Lawquane''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]]/[[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Hybrid/Legends|hybrid]] who lived during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. She was the daughter of [[Suu Lawquane/Legends|Suu]], the adoptive daughter of [[Cut Lawquane/Legends|Cut Lawquane]], and the sister of [[Jek Lawquane/Legends|Jek]].

==Biography==
During the [[Battle of Saleucami/Legends|Battle of Saleucami]], the [[Lawquane family/Legends|Lawquanes]] housed the injured [[Clone Captain/Legends|Clone Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]], who later helped [[Cut Lawquane/Legends|Cut]] defend [[Lawquane farmstead|the farm]] against a group of [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]], which [[Jek Lawquane/Legends|Jek]] and Shaeeah accidentally activated.<ref name="The Deserter" /> 

As an adult, Lawquane wrote ''[[My Stepfather's Face: A Soldier's Secret]]'' about her childhood, identifying Cut as a clone trooper deserter.<ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-9-battlfields-of-the-clone-wars|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 9: Battlefields of the Clone Wars}}</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Personality and traits==
Shaeeah, along with her brother Jek, followed their father in believing that those who need help should not be turned away. She was not afraid to speak up and ask questions when curious about something.<ref name="The Deserter" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shaeeah was voiced by [[Nika Futterman]], who also voices [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' television series]]. The blog ''[[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut]]'' mistakenly identifies Lawquane's homeworld as [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] instead of Saleucami.
